style: Warm editorial scrapbook; cream paper, forest green, terracotta; Roman Hinglish text; 4:5 portrait; BUSINESS JALWA footer with slide number

slides: CUSTOMER WAPAS KYUN AAYE?
Naya customer laana shuruaat hai. Use dobara kharidne ki wajah dena retention hai.
Indian neighborhood shop owner recognizing a returning customer
RETENTION KYA HAI?
Customer ka waqt ke saath business se juda rehna aur dobara kharidna. Har business mein buying cycle alag hota hai.
Customer making a second purchase at a local store
WAJAH DO, SIRF DISCOUNT NAHI
Achhi quality, time par delivery aur helpful service customer ko wapas aane ki wajah dete hain.
Delivery person bringing a neat parcel to pleased customer
EK SIMPLE EXAMPLE
100 naye customers mein se 30 agle mahine phir kharidte hain. Repeat purchase ko alag track karo.
Shopkeeper marking return purchases on a notebook, no invented formulas
PEHLE SUNO, PHIR SUDHARO
Feedback lo. Complaints solve karo. Dekho kaun dobara aata hai. Trust har achhe experience se banta hai.
Shopkeeper listening attentively to a customer
PRICE KAISE TAY KAREIN?
Sirf competitor ka price copy karna kaafi nahi. Cost, customer ki need aur value ko saath dekho.
Craft seller considering a price tag
APNI COST SAMJHO
Material ke saath packaging, delivery, fees aur business chalane ka kharch bhi dekho.
Small craft workshop with materials packaging and calculator
CUSTOMER KO KYA VALUE MILTI HAI?
Quality, convenience aur reliable service bhi value hain. Customer kis baat ke liye pay karta hai, samjho.
Customer comparing well-made useful products
DISCOUNT KA ASAR DEKHO
Price Rs100, cost Rs70: Rs30 bachte hain. Rs10 discount ke baad Rs20. Baaki costs abhi ghataani hain.
Two simple price tags and shopkeeper with calculator
CHHOTE TEST, BEHTAR FAISLE
Price badalne par sales, customer feedback aur bachi rakam track karo. Sirf order count mat dekho.
Shopkeeper reviewing notebook and customer feedback
BREAK-EVEN KYA HAI?
Jab total revenue aur total cost barabar ho: na profit, na loss. Ye ek simple planning point hai.
Cafe owner balancing sales receipts and expense bills
DO TARAH KE COST
Rent jaise fixed cost aur har sale ke saath badhne wale variable cost ko alag samjho.
Cafe rent bill beside ingredients for cups of chai
HAR SALE SE KITNA BACHTA HAI?
Selling price Rs100 - variable cost Rs60 = Rs40 contribution. Ye fixed cost cover karne mein kaam aata hai.
Cafe owner holding a cup with a large simple calculation card
CHHOTA EXAMPLE
Fixed cost Rs4,000 / Rs40 contribution = 100 units. Is simple example mein 100 units par break-even.
Cafe counter with a notebook showing 100 units
YE EK ESTIMATE HAI
Price, cost aur sales mix badlenge toh break-even bhi badlega. Numbers ko regularly update karo.
Cafe owner updating a planning notebook
STOCK BHI PAISA HAI
Inventory woh maal hai jo business bechne ya product banane ke liye rakhta hai. Ismein paisa laga hota hai.
Indian small shopkeeper arranging neatly stocked shelves
BAHUT ZYADA STOCK?
Unsold maal mein cash atak sakta hai. Storage, damage aur expiry ka kharch bhi ho sakta hai.
Shopkeeper examining surplus boxes and expiry dates
BAHUT KAM STOCK?
Customer ko product na mile toh sale miss ho sakti hai. Supplier ka delivery time bhi dhyan mein rakho.
Customer asking shopkeeper for unavailable product on empty shelf
SIMPLE TRACKING SHURU KARO
Kya aaya, kya bika, kitna bacha? Fast-selling aur slow-moving items ko alag dekho.
Shopkeeper using an orderly stock ledger
ANDAAZE SE AAGE BADHO
Pichhli sales, season aur supplier lead time dekhkar order karo. Har item ka stock ek jaisa mat rakho.
Shopkeeper planning next stock order with calendar and shelves
B2B AUR B2C KYA HAI?
Farq customer ka hai: business ko bechna ya seedha consumer ko. Dono ka buying process alag ho sakta hai.
Split editorial scene office buyer and individual shopper
B2B: BUSINESS SE BUSINESS
Jab ek business doosre business ko product ya service bechta hai. Example: offices ke liye software.
Software consultant demonstrating app to office team
B2C: BUSINESS SE CONSUMER
Jab business seedha personal use ke liye customer ko bechta hai. Example: dukaan se apne liye shoes.
Individual customer buying shoes at local store
EK BUSINESS, DONO MODELS
Bakery families ko cakes beche: B2C. Wahi bakery cafes ko bread supply kare: B2B.
Bakery owner supplying cafe bread and serving family cake
CUSTOMER SAMJHO, TAREEKA CHUNO
Order size, decision process aur payment terms alag ho sakte hain. Offer customer ki need ke hisaab se banao.
Entrepreneur thoughtfully planning offers for business and personal customers
